name: Falcon Charmer raises Falcon Dive's duration modifier by 3 sec (#2508)
contract: 705076 'Falcon Charmer' reads 'Increases the duration of War Falcons by 3 sec.' It is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 1 = SPELLMOD_DURATION, BasePoints 2999+1=3000, class mask (0, 0, 2048) = word2 bit 11. Falcon Dive 806341 (the self-cast that summons two War Falcons, DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms; see ranger-war-falcon-focus.json) has SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 2048) = word2 bit 11, a direct match. Spell duration modifiers are applied generically wherever a spell/aura duration is computed for a matching family-27 spell, so no script is needed: the query for Falcon Dive's own duration modifier must rise by exactly 3000 ms once Falcon Charmer is learned.

steps.label: CONTRACT: Falcon Dive's duration modifier rises by 3000 ms
